Epistemology
(album)
Epistemology
is the sixth
studio album
by the Norwegian
extreme metal
band
Keep of Kalessin
, released on 16 February 2015 through Indie.
Natalie Humphries of
Soundscape Magazine
rated the album a 7 out of 10, opining that it "lacks that special something."
